- name: ShellCheck
        run: shellcheck plugin/hooks/*.sh install.sh

      # fuzz has no distributed binary -- only source -- so CI builds it the
      # same way a developer would via z-spec/install.sh --fuzz-only:
      # git clone the pinned commit, configure/make/make install. bison and
      # flex are invoked by literal name in fuzz's own Makefile.in with no
      # autoconf fallback; gcc, make, cpp, and awk are already on
      # ubuntu-latest via build-essential, but bison/flex are not guaranteed,
      # so both are installed explicitly (apt-get is a no-op if already
      # present). This keeps the fuzz-check gate in the Makefile able to
      # ACTUALLY run and ACTUALLY fail in CI -- see the Makefile's
      # fuzz-check target for why a missing binary is a hard failure here
      # and a graceful skip only on a developer's own machine.
      - name: Install fuzz (Z spec type-checker)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bison flex
          ./install.sh --fuzz-only 2>&1 || true
        working-directory: /dev/null
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Test
        run: go test -race -count=1 -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...

      - name: Validate content
        run: go run ./cmd/validate-content

      - name: fuzz type-check (Z specs)
        run: make fuzz-check
